title: My game is not working on my friends pc, what to do?

posts.author: Zlek0
posts.body:
So basically, I just made my first game on RPG Maker XP (since this was cheap and stuff) and so everything worked just fine and all. Until when my friend tried opening the game after dowloading (it was as the exe file and aswell as the zip file) they recieved an error with "RGSS-RTP Standard not founf" which was odd bc when i dowloaded it again, the game worked for me :/ (We both have Windows 11)  Tried deleting and re-installing but nothing worked out.
So like I did search abt the issue and saw others having it aswell (well maybe bit different since they dind't get the error message and just the black screen) and that apparently it was the antivirus issue or just overall Windows update destroying it all and stuff... sometimes even fault of the outdated data. But I have no idea how to fix that, like sure, my pal can just turn off the anti virus and stuff and yet it still won't work, cuz that "file" is missin and damn I have no idea where to find that "file" when it's supposed to be in the game already.
And if it is the Windows Updates fault, then how to fix it? Do I have to do anything or is it only on my friends side? And if so, what does my friend have to do to fix it and be able to play my game?

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body:
That's because you have to include the rtp files when deploying your game, or your friend has to install the XP rtp manually.
RPG Maker RTP Downloads | RPG Maker | Make A Game!

posts.author: Zlek0
posts.body: Okay so I did try dowloading it, aswell as my friend did but that didn't work. I went into the scripts tho and changed the default rpt into nothing (since i managed to find it in a different forum) and that worked then so thanks

posts.author: kyonides
posts.body: The removal of the Standard RTP package from the Game.ini file works as long as you don't include anything from that RTP in your game or you copied and pasted some of those files in their respective game folders. Just keep that in mind.
